newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: YUGO TO HOST FIRST INVESTOR CONFERENCE IN OCTOBER.
newsitem.headline: YUGO TO HOST FIRST INVESTOR CONFERENCE IN OCTOBER.

text.p: Yugoslavia will host its first investor conference in October, hoping to attract businesses from nine European countries and the United States, Belgrade daily Politika said on Friday.
The two-day "Yugo-Forum", to open on October 14, will be organised by the London-based Pan-European Conferences, specialised in banking and investment gatherings.
Co-organisers are the Yugoslav Chamber of Commerce's Investment and Joint Venture Bureau, the Yugoslav Finance Ministry, Serbia's Development Fund and the Yugoslav Banking Association.

"Pan-European has already informed 19 financial institutions and government agencies from Great Britain, Germany, France, Belgium, Israel, Austria, Luxembourg, Netherlands and the U.S., most of which have agreed to come," Politika said quoting an unnamed source from Pan-European.

Foreigners are expected to present in Belgrade financial possibilities, ways of financing offered projects and "specific rules of the game", the paper said. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 311 4254
